# Third-party browser assets

Only files required by the published blog are kept here.

- Marked 18.0.14 — `marked/marked.umd.js` — MIT license
- DOMPurify 3.4.16 — `dompurify/purify.min.js` — Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0
- KaTeX 0.18.9 — `katex/katex.min.js`, `katex/katex.min.css`, and WOFF2 fonts — MIT license

The original license files are retained beside each library. KaTeX's TTF and
WOFF fallbacks and npm-only package metadata are intentionally omitted from the
published site.
